decisions.thought: The opponent's team leans on Water types and bulky walls (Toxapex, Blastoise, Steelix, Rotom-Wash), plus Garchomp and Gengar. Gholdengo hits most of them with Make It Rain and Shadow Ball, and Kingambit punishes Gengar. Garchomp leads with Swords Dance pressure, and Mega Earthquake handles Gengar, Toxapex and Steelix.

Rotomwash is the only Pokémon that can 4× hit the opponent’s Garchomp and also neutralise their Rotomwash.  Toxapex will set up Toxic Spikes and recover, and Gengar can take on Steel/Ghost threats and finish off any switch‑ins.  This trio covers the main threats and gives a fast, powerful lead.
